items.title: Edmond "Doc" Souchon Interview, 1962-02-17
items.q: Irene Castle and Osborne came and played at the St. Charles.

ctx.x: Once, one or fewer, the younger people would. But the only dance that they had then at the time was the two-step, but that became extremely intricate. The steps had developed along with that. And it was not because the, what do you call them, the castles came. Irene Castle and Osborne came and played at the St. Charles. Had a very fine place upstairs. Piran was a band, and they danced, the castles danced to them. But that didn't influence the dancing that we did. We were moving along. Who brought it in, I don't…
